test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question: Which option is WRONG?

options.text: Secondary data requires less time and money than primary data
Secondary data is less reliable and less suitable than primary data
Secondary data refer to those data that have already been collected by some other person.

solution:
The correct answer is: **"Secondary data is original".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Secondary data** refers to data that have already been collected by someone else, not original data. 
 
• Secondary data can be faster and more cost-effective to access than primary data.
 
• Secondary data's reliability depends on the source, quality and relevance of the data.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Secondary data can come from various sources, including government agencies, market research firms, trade associations, and online databases.
 
• Secondary data can provide a broad overview and context for a particular topic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The suitability of secondary data for a specific research project depends on the research objectives, data quality and relevance, and the research methods used.
 
• In some cases, secondary data may not be sufficient or relevant to answer a specific research question, requiring the collection of primary data.
